title: keyval.server.init/v1
description: The report `keyval-server init --json` prints on stdout once it has initialised a node's data directory (crates/server/src/output.rs; PLAN.md §7.7 step 0, DUR-8, O-6): the binding its genesis frame records. Exit status 0. Any refusal prints keyval.server.error/v1 instead.

data_dir.description: The data directory, resolved against the config file's directory.

directory.description: created: this init created the directory; existing: it was already there, as an interrupted init leaves it.

replaced.description: What an interrupted init had left in the journal, which this one replaced: an empty journal or an incomplete genesis frame; null for a new journal.

cluster_id.description: The configured cluster name: display only (D-63).

instance_id.description: The cluster instance ID the genesis carries: 32 lowercase hex digits (D-63).

voters.description: The voter set the genesis binds, in configuration order.

journal_bytes.description: The journal's length afterwards: exactly the genesis frame.
